summary: No REQ-010.3.1 test exercises an image attachment (ComposerAttachment.Kind.image, which carries real binary Data) to confirm attachment contents don't leak into prompt_submitted properties; the only attachment test uses a content-less FileReferenceAttachment, so the 'attachment contents' conjunct has no rejected counterexample. Additionally, the strongest real leak-prevention evidence for filesystem paths and model/provider names (real working-directory paths and real PiModelOption selections verified absent from pi_load_failed/handled_exception properties) is tagged only REQ-010.1.1/1.2, not REQ-010.3.1, so this requirement's tagged evidence relies mainly on a single synthetic forbidden-string proxy for those conjuncts rather than real data flows.
